title: Divergence theorem with trace estimate on Q_δ for C¹ functions (0 ≤ δ ≤ 1/4)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, 0 ≤ δ ≤ 1/4 and Q_δ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i} ⊆ Euclid n (Lebesgue measure), div G := trace DG. For every C¹ function v : ℝⁿ → ℝ and every C¹ map G : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with |G(y)| ≤ 1 for all y: |∫_{Q_δ} v · div G| ≤ (2n + 1) ∫_{Q_δ} ‖Dv‖ + 4n ∫_{Q_δ} |v|, where 2n + 1 = 2(m + 1) + 1 and 4n = 4(m + 1).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (δ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → (∀ y, ‖G y‖ ≤ 1) → 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ 1 / 4 → |∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, v x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G x)| ≤ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) * (∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖) + 4 * (m + 1) * ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |v x|
